definitions.final_results: Final CEC results for the 26th Knesset (votes26), as certified.

largest_list.instructions: Which list will win the most seats in the 26th Knesset?
largest_list.resolution: List with the most seats in the final CEC results. A tie is broken by valid votes.

yashar_largest.instructions: Will Yashar win more seats than any other list?
yashar_largest.resolution: Same resolution as largest_list. Consistency pair with largest_list.

second_list.instructions: Which list will come second in seats?
second_list.resolution: Second-largest list by seats, ties broken by valid votes.

third_list.instructions: Which list will come third in seats?
third_list.resolution: Third-largest list by seats, ties broken by valid votes.

likud_below_32.instructions: Will Likud win fewer than 32 seats, its 2022 total?
likud_below_32.resolution: Likud seats in the final CEC results are 31 or fewer. Consistency pair with seats_likud.

netanyahu_bloc_61.instructions: Will the Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionist Party – Zehut, Noam) win 61 or more seats combined?
netanyahu_bloc_61.resolution: Sum of seats for Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionist Party – Zehut, Noam in the final CEC results is at least 61.

opposition_zionist_61.instructions: Will the Zionist opposition lists (Yashar, Together (B'Yachad), The Democrats, Yisrael Beiteinu, The Reservists and the Economic Party, Amcha Yisrael) win 61 or more seats combined, without the Arab lists?
opposition_zionist_61.resolution: Sum of seats for Yashar, Together (B'Yachad), The Democrats, Yisrael Beiteinu, The Reservists and the Economic Party, Amcha Yisrael is at least 61.

no_bloc_majority.instructions: Will neither the Netanyahu bloc nor the Zionist opposition reach 61 seats on its own?
no_bloc_majority.resolution: Both netanyahu_bloc_61 and opposition_zionist_61 resolve false.

bloc_most_seats.instructions: Which bloc will win more seats?

criteria.netanyahu: Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionist Party – Zehut, Noam)
criteria.opposition: Zionist opposition (Yashar, Together (B'Yachad), The Democrats, Yisrael Beiteinu, The Reservists and the Economic Party, Amcha Yisrael)

bloc_most_seats.resolution: Compare the Netanyahu bloc's seats with the Zionist opposition's seats, as defined above.

netanyahu_bloc_seats.instructions: How many seats will the Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionist Party – Zehut, Noam) win combined?

next_pm.instructions: Who will be prime minister of the first government sworn in after this election?
next_pm.resolution: Prime minister of the first government that wins a Knesset confidence vote after 27 Oct 2026. Resolves 'other' if none by 2027-02-28.

netanyahu_remains_pm.instructions: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be prime minister of the first government formed after this election?
netanyahu_remains_pm.resolution: Same resolution as next_pm == netanyahu. Consistency pair with next_pm.

eisenkot_pm.instructions: Will Gadi Eisenkot be prime minister of the first government formed after this election?

first_mandate.instructions: Whom will President Herzog task first with forming a government?

govt_by_2026_12_31.instructions: Will a new government be sworn in by 31 December 2026?
govt_by_2026_12_31.resolution: A government wins a Knesset confidence vote on or before 2026-12-31.

another_election_called.instructions: Will the 26th Knesset dissolve, triggering another election, before any government is formed?
another_election_called.resolution: The Knesset dissolves or an election is set by law before any government wins a confidence vote.

smotrich_finance.instructions: Will Bezalel Smotrich be finance minister in the first government formed after this election?

coalition_size.instructions: How many Knesset seats will the first government formed after this election command?

oct7_state_commission.instructions: Will the government establish a state commission of inquiry into the 7 October 2023 attack by 30 June 2027?
oct7_state_commission.resolution: A state commission of inquiry under the Commissions of Inquiry Law, 1968, is established by government decision on or before 2027-06-30.

haredi_draft_law.instructions: Will the Knesset pass a law on conscription of Haredi yeshiva students by 30 June 2027?
haredi_draft_law.resolution: A law setting the military or national-service obligations of yeshiva students passes its third reading on or before 2027-06-30.

netanyahu_pardon.instructions: Will Benjamin Netanyahu receive a presidential pardon, or end his criminal trial through a plea deal, by 30 June 2027?
netanyahu_pardon.resolution: A pardon is granted or a plea agreement is approved by the court on or before 2027-06-30.

netanyahu_likud_leader_2027.instructions: Will Benjamin Netanyahu still be Likud chairman on 30 June 2027?
netanyahu_likud_leader_2027.resolution: Netanyahu holds the Likud chairmanship on 2027-06-30.

netanyahu_pm_mid_2027.instructions: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be prime minister, including as caretaker, on 30 June 2027?
netanyahu_pm_mid_2027.resolution: Netanyahu holds the office of prime minister on 2027-06-30, whether in a new government or a transitional one.

saudi_normalisation.instructions: Will Israel and Saudi Arabia sign a normalisation agreement by 31 December 2027?
saudi_normalisation.resolution: Both governments sign a formal agreement establishing diplomatic relations on or before 2027-12-31.
